request: Make a bb plugin for bb mobile to have like arrows or tinder stylrer to go strong it the threads more easily. You teasesrch and do it don’t ask me
message: Prevent BB's sidebar-opening horizontal gesture from firing when the user swipes inside Dockside's mobile thread-navigation strip. The strip's deliberate horizontal swipe must navigate exactly one thread and consume propagation/default behavior only once the gesture is recognized; vertical scrolling and gestures outside the strip must remain unchanged.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Replace the currently installed Dockside v0.1.5 with this updated Dockside build, verify it is running, then create and push the new Dockside v0.1.6 release.

sizeDecision.reason: Installation replacement and immutable release are the final delivery of the already atomic Dockside ownership migration; splitting would create a release without proving the installed artifact or an installation without the requested release.
